behavior: Six scenarios cover new ticket, existing-ticket reply, missing defaults, acknowledgement failure, attachment failure and unrecoverable resolution failure.
Real Temporal workflow execution invokes actual node/action activities, output schemas, idempotency persistence, encrypted retry storage, snapshot projection and run completion.
Persisted snapshots verify original payload, processedAt, parsed metadata, context/defaults/location, created ticket identity and final business state.
Invocation rows prove tenant-prefixed message/provider/ticket idempotency keys and persisted failures; handler assertions verify mapped contact authorship and tenant/provider/sender inputs.
Manual resolution preserves failure context and the intermediate error state in actual snapshots.
limits: Pinned-definition loading and step-start insertion are fixture seams; application start authorization, pinned-version loading and quota reservation are not proved here.
External effects and context/ticket resolution use synthetic registered action handlers; provider delivery, actual ticket creation and real context/thread lookup require their own coverage.

Retired outer-catch cases threw the parser, which now has intentional fallback behavior. The active catch regression injects an unrecoverable resolution failure to verify the same manual-resolution behavior.
